name: MonarchComparisonSection
title: ComparisonSection
summary: A band that compares the product with alternatives: a header, a table of capabilities by option, cards that say whom each option suits, a note on sources and the actions.
whenToUse: On a welcome or product tour screen that explains how the product differs from the tools people use today, with neutral, sourced rows.
whenNotToUse: To compare the product's own plans, use MonarchPricingSection or MonarchPricingTable.
api: @Composable fun MonarchComparisonSection(columns: List<MonarchComparisonColumn>, rows: List<MonarchComparisonRow>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, title: String? = null, eyebrow: String? = null, description: String? = null, bestFor: List<MonarchComparisonBestFor> = emptyList(), note: String? = null, align: MonarchMarketingAlign = MonarchMarketingAlign.Start, tone: MonarchMarketingSectionTone = MonarchMarketingSectionTone.Default, caption: String? = null, actions: (@Composable FlowRowScope.() -> Unit)? = null)
class MonarchComparisonColumn(id: String, name: String, highlighted: Boolean = false, badge: String? = null)
class MonarchComparisonRow(id: String, label: String, values: Map<String, MonarchPricingFeatureValue>, group: String? = null, description: String? = null)
class MonarchComparisonBestFor(id: String, title: String, description: String, highlighted: Boolean = false)

options.name: columns
options.description: The options in display order: id, name, highlighted flag and badge.

options.name: rows
options.description: The capabilities: id, label, a value per column id (Included, NotIncluded or Text), group and description.

options.name: title
options.description: The title, read as a heading.

options.name: eyebrow
options.description: A short line above the title, in the accent.

options.name: description
options.description: The muted line under the title.

options.name: bestFor
options.description: Cards under the table: whom each option suits.

options.name: note
options.description: A muted note on a subtle fill: when the comparison was checked and against which sources.

options.name: align
options.description: The header at the start edge or centred.

options.name: tone
options.description: No fill, or the subtle background.

options.name: caption
options.description: The spoken name of the table. null uses the title, then "Plan comparison".

states.name: highlighted column
states.description: The column has the accent border in the header and its badge.

states.name: grouped rows
states.description: Rows with a group are listed under its heading.

states.name: highlighted best-for card
states.description: The card is the subtle accent with the accent border.

appearance: The table uses MonarchPricingTable's roles: subtle-border row lines, group headings on the subtle background, an accent border around the highlighted header. Best-for cards use the surface with the default border, or the subtle accent with the accent border; the note the subtle background with muted text. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web table scrolls sideways on narrow screens with the first column pinned. On Android the table is MonarchPricingTable in its grid layout, with every column at least 152dp wide (scaled with the font size); when that is wider than the screen the table scrolls sideways, so no word is broken. The capability column scrolls with the rest rather than staying pinned. Values are MonarchPricingFeatureValue, so a check, a dash or text.
accessibility: The table is a traversal group named by caption or the title; each cell is read as the option, the capability and the value, such as "Spreadsheets, Change history: Per file".
Checks and dashes are not read; the words carry the value.
The title, group headings and best-for titles are headings; each best-for card is read as one element.
edgeCases: On a phone the table usually scrolls sideways; the capability column is not pinned.
An option missing from a row's values does not have the capability.

examples.title: Product beside manual alternatives
examples.code:
MonarchComparisonSection(
    columns = listOf(
        MonarchComparisonColumn(id = "product", name = "Product A", highlighted = true, badge = "This product"),
        MonarchComparisonColumn(id = "sheets", name = "Spreadsheets"),
        MonarchComparisonColumn(id = "email", name = "Email threads"),
    ),
    rows = listOf(
        MonarchComparisonRow(
            id = "history",
            label = "Change history",
            values = mapOf(
                "product" to MonarchPricingFeatureValue.Included,
                "sheets" to MonarchPricingFeatureValue.Text("Per file"),
                "email" to MonarchPricingFeatureValue.NotIncluded,
            ),
        ),
        MonarchComparisonRow(
            id = "assign",
            label = "Assign an owner",
            values = mapOf(
                "product" to MonarchPricingFeatureValue.Included,
                "sheets" to MonarchPricingFeatureValue.NotIncluded,
                "email" to MonarchPricingFeatureValue.NotIncluded,
            ),
        ),
        MonarchComparisonRow(
            id = "roles",
            label = "Roles and permissions",
            group = "Access",
            values = mapOf(
                "product" to MonarchPricingFeatureValue.Included,
                "sheets" to MonarchPricingFeatureValue.Text("Per file"),
                "email" to MonarchPricingFeatureValue.NotIncluded,
            ),
        ),
        MonarchComparisonRow(
            id = "export",
            label = "Export to CSV",
            group = "Access",
            values = mapOf(
                "product" to MonarchPricingFeatureValue.Included,
                "sheets" to MonarchPricingFeatureValue.Included,
                "email" to MonarchPricingFeatureValue.NotIncluded,
            ),
        ),
    ),
    title = "How it compares",
    eyebrow = "Compare",
    description = "Neutral sample rows for documentation.",
    bestFor = listOf(
        MonarchComparisonBestFor(
            id = "product",
            title = "Product A suits",
            description = "Teams that share and hand over work every day.",
            highlighted = true,
        ),
        MonarchComparisonBestFor(id = "sheets", title = "Spreadsheets suit", description = "One-off lists kept by one person."),
    ),
    note = "Sample note: say when the comparison was checked and against which public sources, and credit trademarks to their owners.",
) {
    MonarchButton(text = "Try Product A", onClick = { tried = true }, variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Primary)
}
